summary: Iteration 6 - QR Deluxe-only verification. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (plans, auto-has_qr on create, generate-qr endpoint 200/403, qr-filters shape+403, qr-labels scope=all/item/main_group x size=small/medium/large PDFs, basic 403, club logo overlay). Frontend: /app/utstyr renders qr-labels-btn, 3 size options, scope dropdown, download btn; per-vare Generer QR works end-to-end (toast + row refresh + QR icon). Sidebar Skann QR link present; /app/skann renders with start-scan-btn.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate import of 'toast' from 'sonner' AND duplicate 'const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)' causing webpack SyntaxError 'Identifier toast has already been declared' which crashed the app with 'Compiled with problems' overlay. Fixed by testing agent to allow further testing.

action_items: Review Inventory.jsx merge - duplicate imports were introduced; verify no other stale duplicates remain across pages after merges.
server.py is now ~2234 lines - consider splitting QR, invoices, notifications into separate routers.
qr-labels endpoint still iterates up to 5000 items and renders PNGs sync - may timeout on large tenants; consider background job/stream.
critical_code_review_comments: Inventory.jsx had duplicate `toast` import and duplicate `useState(false)` for `open` - E1 likely merged QR changes on top of an older file revision. These were caught by webpack but could easily reach production if not linted.

qr-labels inventory_qr_labels loads full item docs then re-generates QR + logo overlay in a sync loop; for 500+ items this will exceed request timeout. Move to a background renderer or batched streaming.
qr-filters returns the full items list (up to 5000) just to compute distinct groups client-side - add a $group aggregation and only return items when the dialog needs them (lazy load).
generate_item_qr returns the raw mongo doc; consider _clean() wrapper for consistency (currently it filters _id via projection so safe).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testids verified + end-to-end Generer QR flow works)

seed_data_creation: Test module provisions a TEST_It6_deluxe_* tenant (basic→upgraded to deluxe by owner) and a TEST_It6_basic_* tenant for plan-gating. Soft-deletes via /api/owner/customers/{id} on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: QR module is deluxe-only. Admin tenant 000001 is deluxe → has qr-labels-btn and gen-qr buttons for items created on legacy basic plans. The /api/items/{id}/generate-qr endpoint sets has_qr=True; subsequent list_items reflect change immediately. qr-labels is only reachable with qr_codes feature flag.
rca of the issue: Duplicate `toast` import + duplicate `open` state in Inventory.jsx = compile error. Root cause: merge of QR-dialog branch over an older Inventory.jsx that already imported toast and declared `open` state. Mitigation applied: removed the duplicates. Preventive: run `yarn lint`/eslint before commit; add no-duplicate-imports rule.
